question: Compare single-sensor versus all non-fixed non-driving sensor policies on HP5 direct and pulley-reduced with small isolated headless experiments; measure information, flex bias, acquisition reliability and time without disturbing the live first-manual-autocal-of-hp5-pulley-reduced run or doing unnecessary full runs.

agents.question: HP5 direct: Compare the current single active sensor plus compliant redundant axis against using both non-fixed non-driving low axes as torque-controlled sensors. Run several SMALL isolated headless experiments, no full autocal runs. Determine slack cause, acquisition stability/coverage, measured-range information gain, force/flex bias and equal-time or equal-point calibration value. Read prior autocal topic insights; use truth only as diagnostics. Preserve scripts, manifests and concise report.

HP5 pulley-reduced: independently compare the current single active sensor plus compliant redundant axis against both available non-fixed non-driving torque-controlled sensors using several SMALL isolated headless experiments, no full autocal runs. Test whether redundant pretension frees extra informative ranges or creates uncontrolled self-stress/flex bias; compare reliability/coverage/wall and simulation time, range/anchor fit accuracy at matched budget. Preserve reproducible scripts, manifests and concise report.

Independently review the completed direct HP5 sensor-policy experiment, inspect units, force calibration and statistical information claims, and reproduce one decisive short matched native-headless comparison. Assess evidence for sensor benefit versus bias, including limitations of the offset-free synthetic fit. No full runs or production changes.

Independently review reduced HP5 matched short-collection evidence for two sensors; verify fitter, force and offset handling, claimed information gains and coverage tradeoffs. Resolve whether extra measured ranges genuinely improve rough calibration versus the same force policy with four ranges; no full runs.

Run a predeclared paired full autocalibration test on HP5 pulley-reduced: current policy versus measurement-only second-sensor acquisition with all five ranges, correct force/offset bookkeeping, and observable validity handling. Develop and validate the experiment-only integrated prototype first; run at most one baseline and one treatment full run initially, preserving unchanged production stopping rules and isolated worlds.
